name: Log In
goal: Establish a browser session or obtain a JWT.
pre: Enabled, unlocked account.
flow: Visitor submits credentials through the form or authentication API.
System verifies password and account state.
Successful browser login records success and redirects by role; API login returns authentication data.
alt: Invalid credentials reject login; repeated failures can lock the account.
rules: Session/JWT login is separate from company API-key authentication.

name: Log Out
pre: Authenticated browser session.
flow: User selects logout.
Spring Security invalidates the session and clears authentication.
Browser returns to login.
alt: An unauthenticated browser has no session to end.
rules: Browser logout does not revoke JWTs or API keys.

name: Change Own Password
pre: Authenticated account.
flow: User submits current and replacement passwords.
System checks current password and confirmation.
System encodes and saves the replacement.
alt: Incorrect password or mismatching confirmation prevents change.
rules: All authenticated roles can reach /users/change-password.

name: Reset Forgotten Password
goal: Recover access using a reset token.
pre: Registered email; email delivery configured.
flow: Visitor requests reset.
System creates a time-limited token and sends a link.
Visitor submits token and new password.
System validates token, saves encoded password and consumes token.
alt: Unknown email does not change an account; expired/used tokens cannot reset it.
rules: Reset request alone does not change credentials.

name: Manage Users
pre: Admin authentication.
flow: Admin lists users and submits account/role changes.
System checks uniqueness and authority/company associations.
System encodes passwords when applicable and saves the user.
System displays the result.
alt: Activate/deactivate and lock/unlock are alternative operations; duplicate username/email/ID rejects save.
rules: Delete deactivates the account. Chiefs use an authority set; company users can link to a company.

name: Manage Traditional Authorities
pre: Admin writes; Admin or scoped Chief reads.
flow: Actor opens authority list/detail.
Admin submits details, leadership and optional boundary.
System validates name, leadership and spatial data.
System saves authority and user links.
alt: Chief reads linked authorities and uses UC-14; this does not grant Chief Admin CRUD. Duplicate names or invalid assignments reject save.
rules: Headsman assignment is limited to one authority by service checks; chief_id remains alongside chief_authorities.
post: Authority and leadership links are stored.

name: Link Chief to Traditional Authority
pre: Admin; existing Chief and authorities.
flow: Admin selects Chief authority assignments.
System resolves records and updates the authority set.
System persists chief_authorities links.
Scope resolution uses those links.
alt: Existing links are not duplicated; legacy fields remain.
rules: Chief–Authority is many-to-many.
post: Chief scope reflects the linked set.

name: View Audit Trail
pre: Admin authentication.
flow: Admin opens audit trail and selects filters.
System retrieves matching audit entries.
System displays event details.
alt: No matches produces an empty result.
rules: Audit and company API usage are separate; not all operations emit audit events.

name: Manage Companies
pre: Admin; existing selected company/key for existing-record operations.
flow: Admin submits company details.
System checks unique name/registration and saves ACTIVE company.
Admin may disable with reason or reactivate.
alt: Duplicate company or missing existing record rejects change.
rules: API usage is separate from audit_logs. Company: ACTIVE/DISABLED; key: ACTIVE/REVOKED.

name: Generate Company API Key
pre: Admin; existing selected company/key for existing-record operations.
flow: Admin selects company, label and scopes.
System requires active company and generates and hashes random key.
System saves digest, prefix, scopes and ACTIVE status.
System returns raw key once.
alt: Disabled company cannot receive new key.
rules: API usage is separate from audit_logs. Company: ACTIVE/DISABLED; key: ACTIVE/REVOKED.

name: Revoke Company API Key
pre: Admin; existing selected company/key for existing-record operations.
flow: Admin selects company key and reason.
System checks company/key association.
System marks REVOKED with actor and time.
alt: Wrong-company key is rejected.
rules: API usage is separate from audit_logs. Company: ACTIVE/DISABLED; key: ACTIVE/REVOKED.

name: View Company API Usage
pre: Admin; existing selected company/key for existing-record operations.
flow: Admin opens company usage.
System retrieves usage records and summaries.
System displays status, reason and time.
alt: No records yields empty list.
rules: API usage is separate from audit_logs. Company: ACTIVE/DISABLED; key: ACTIVE/REVOKED.

name: View Dashboard
pre: Authenticated account.
flow: User opens dashboard.
System resolves role and applicable authority scope.
System calculates summaries and renders dashboard.
alt: No data produces empty/zero summaries.
rules: Dashboard route permits every authenticated role.

name: Manage Villages
pre: Chief; linked authority.
flow: Chief selects authority and enters village details, headsman and boundary.
System checks scope, name and headsman assignment.
System saves village and relevant links.
System displays village.
alt: Duplicate village name within authority or out-of-scope selection rejects operation; editing/deactivation use existing records.
rules: Village routes are CHIEF-only, including reads. Authority has many villages.

name: Manage Parcels
pre: Staff; accessible village for scoped staff.
flow: Staff selects village and submits parcel/stand details and coordinates.
System validates village, boundary and applicable overlap rules.
System generates parcel number and saves parcel/boundary.
System displays detail or batch result.
alt: Admin/Chief change status; staff allocate via allocation endpoint; only Admin deletes. Invalid geometry, duplicate stand or overlap rejects where checked.
rules: Scope checks vary by route; sync is separate. Parcel uses version token.

name: Manage PTOs
pre: Staff; accessible parcel for scoped staff.
flow: Staff selects AVAILABLE parcel and submits holder, stand, purpose and dates.
System derives village/authority and requires stand match.
System rejects ACTIVE/SUSPENDED PTO conflicts.
System saves PENDING PTO and publishes creation event.
Staff views or edits through available routes.
alt: Missing parcel/village/authority or unavailable parcel rejects creation. Upload supporting documents separately.
rules: Creation does not allocate parcel. Community-resolution flag requires submitted flag and AGRICULTURAL/BUSINESS purpose.

name: Approve PTO
pre: Chief; PENDING/SUSPENDED PTO; scope and creator rules satisfied.
flow: Chief submits notes and optional signature.
System validates status and creator rights.
System requires ID_COPY, TA_ALLOCATION_LETTER and SITE_SKETCH types and no competing ACTIVE PTO.
System sets ACTIVE and approval metadata; stores optional signature.
System sets parcel ALLOCATED and PTO pointer and publishes event.
alt: Missing documents, wrong Chief/status or competing PTO rejects approval.
rules: Chief-created PTO requires same creator; other/legacy creators require Chief. Document presence, not content, is checked.
post: PTO ACTIVE; parcel allocated; optional signature stored.

name: Suspend PTO
pre: Staff; chosen route scope; PTO ACTIVE.
flow: Actor selects PTO and enters reason/notes.
System validates transition.
System saves SUSPENDED, reason and time.
System publishes suspension event; parcel status unchanged.
alt: Missing record, invalid transition or conflict rejects operation.
rules: Route/service checks govern access, not approval rules. REST Admin/Chief; page handlers use staff-level route access and scope checks without equivalent method role guards.

name: Reactivate PTO
pre: Staff; chosen route scope; PTO SUSPENDED.
flow: Actor selects PTO and enters reason/notes.
System validates transition.
System rejects competing ACTIVE PTO.
System reactivates and publishes status-change event.
alt: Missing record, invalid transition or conflict rejects operation.
rules: Route/service checks govern access, not approval rules. REST Admin/Chief; page handlers use staff-level route access and scope checks without equivalent method role guards.
post: PTO ACTIVE; no parcel reallocation here.

name: Revoke PTO
pre: Staff; chosen route scope; PTO ACTIVE/SUSPENDED.
flow: Actor selects PTO and enters reason/notes.
System validates transition.
System saves REVOKED, reason, actor and time.
System sets parcel AVAILABLE, clears pointer and publishes event.
alt: Missing record, invalid transition or conflict rejects operation.
rules: Route/service checks govern access, not approval rules. REST Admin/Chief; page handlers use staff-level route access and scope checks without equivalent method role guards.

name: Reinstate PTO
pre: Staff; chosen route scope; PTO REVOKED.
flow: Actor selects PTO and enters reason/notes.
System validates transition.
System rejects competing ACTIVE PTO.
System reinstates PTO and updates parcel allocation.
System publishes reinstatement event.
alt: Missing record, invalid transition or conflict rejects operation.
rules: Route/service checks govern access, not approval rules. REST Admin/Chief; page handlers use staff-level route access and scope checks without equivalent method role guards.

name: Delete PTO
pre: Staff through page route; Admin/Chief through REST; existing nondeleted PTO.
flow: Actor requests deletion.
System rejects already-deleted PTO.
System sets deletion metadata and REVOKED with deletion reason.
System saves and publishes PTODeletedEvent.
alt: Missing record rejects deletion.
rules: No ACTIVE/SUSPENDED prohibition in delete service. Parcel pointer/status is not changed. Row remains in database.

name: Download PTO Certificate
pre: Staff; accessible PTO.
flow: Actor requests certificate.
Controller checks access and loads PTO.
Generator draws holder, tenure and authority details.
System streams PDF.
alt: Missing PTO rejects; rendering failure returns error.
rules: Certificate prints full holder ID.

name: Manage Documents
pre: Staff; target entity reference.
flow: Actor selects entity/type and file.
System checks file size, MIME type and nonempty content.
System stores content/metadata and access log.
Actor lists, downloads or deletes via available routes.
alt: Unsupported MIME, oversized/empty file or missing document rejects operation. Deactivation and permanent deletion are Admin/Chief on REST; staff upload/view/update.
rules: Required PTO types: ID_COPY, TA_ALLOCATION_LETTER, SITE_SKETCH. Polymorphic entity reference is not FK.

name: View GIS Map
pre: Staff authentication.
flow: Actor opens GIS map.
System retrieves parcels under applicable scope.
Map displays geometry and details.
alt: No geometry gives no corresponding feature.
rules: gis_layers does not imply layer-management UI.

name: View My PTOs and Proof Access
pre: Resident user or Admin account.
flow: User opens portal.
System finds nondeleted PTOs by user/holder ID match.
System unions explicit access links for nondeleted PTOs.
Portal displays accessible and owned lists.
alt: No matching ID/links yields empty portal.
rules: Ownership is ID equality, not household membership; no ACTIVE-only filter here.

name: Download Proof of Residence
pre: Portal user owns or has explicit access.
flow: User opens proof form.
System checks access.
User supplies own password.
System verifies password and generates proof with requester name/ID.
System streams PDF.
alt: Wrong password redirects without download; no access rejects.
rules: No ACTIVE/unexpired eligibility check here; password gates download, not PDF encryption.

name: Manage Proof of Residence Access
pre: Portal actor owns nondeleted PTO by ID match.
flow: Owner selects PTO and searches users.
System filters candidates.
Owner submits add/remove and password confirmation.
System checks owner, target and duplicate restrictions.
System inserts/deletes access link.
alt: Nonowner cannot manage; owner cannot be removed; duplicate links reject add.
rules: Candidates include enabled USER/ADMIN accounts; sharing does not transfer ownership.

name: Manage Own API Keys
pre: Company browser account linked to company.
flow: User opens keys.
System resolves company from username.
User requests generation/revocation.
System applies company/key rules; raw generated key shown once.
alt: Missing link rejects; disabled company cannot generate; foreign key cannot be revoked.
rules: No caller-selected company.

name: View Own Company Profile and API Usage
pre: Company browser account linked to company.
flow: User opens own company page.
System derives company from username.
System retrieves profile, keys and usage.
System displays summaries.
alt: Missing association rejects; no logs gives empty list.
rules: Browser role differs from API scopes.

name: Verify Proof of Residence (API)
pre: Active company/key with POR_READ; within rate limits.
flow: Company submits X-API-Key and 13-digit ID to POST /api/external/por/verify.
Filter authenticates digest/key/company and per-key rate limit.
Endpoint checks scope/input and repeated-ID limit.
Service finds first nondeleted ACTIVE PTO not past expiry.
If found, name comes from resident or holder; response contains masked-ID proof fields.
Filter attempts usage recording with ID hash.
alt: 401 authentication; 403 scope; 429 throttling; invalid input rejected. No valid PTO and unknown person both return verified=false, NOT_FOUND.
rules: No PDF. Resident lookup follows PTO lookup. Usage writes are best-effort, separate transaction.

name: Read Own Company Information (API)
pre: Active API key/company; COMPANY_SELF_READ.
flow: Company calls /api/external/self/company, /keys or /usage.
Filter authenticates and rate-limits.
Endpoint checks scope and derives company from principal.
System returns own summary and attempts usage logging.
alt: 401/403/429 reject request; no raw key returned.
rules: Read-only external endpoints, not key management.

name: Expire Overdue PTOs
pre: Scheduler enabled; ACTIVE records.
flow: Daily 01:00 job loads ACTIVE PTOs.
For each with nonnull expiry before today, system sets EXPIRED and saves.
System publishes expiry event; listeners record supported activity.
alt: Null, today or future expiry dates remain unchanged; other statuses not selected.
rules: Parcel is not released by expiry job. Notification recipient is literal system.

name: Capture Electronic Signature
pre: Valid Chief approval; signature supplied in API request.
flow: Chief supplies signatureData or signatureImagePath with approval.
After approval validations, system saves signature with PTO ID and signer metadata.
Approval completes.
alt: Absent signature skips storage without blocking approval.
rules: Extends UC-17 when either signature field is supplied; not cryptographic signing.

name: Register Resident Account
pre: Unauthenticated visitor; unique account identifiers.
flow: Visitor submits registration details and password.
Service checks username, email and supplied ID uniqueness.
System hashes password and creates enabled, unlocked ROLE_USER account.
Visitor is redirected to sign in.
alt: Duplicate identifiers reject registration.
rules: No staff or company role selected through registration.

name: Search TALOMS Records
pre: Authenticated account.
flow: User submits query to global search.
System searches authorities, villages, parcels and PTOs.
System combines results and total.
UI displays matches.
alt: Blank query yields empty results; exceptions in each category produce an empty category.
rules: No scope service is invoked by GlobalSearchController; do not infer uniform authority filtering from navigation.

name: Synchronize Parcel and PTO Changes
pre: Staff; sync client with records/timestamps.
flow: Client requests delta since timestamp.
System returns changed records and server time.
Client pushes changed records.
Service saves batch and returns processed counts.
alt: Invalid delta timestamp is ignored; parcel business validation conflict returns 409.
rules: Sync routes have distinct checks from interactive forms; no universal offline conflict-resolution guarantee.
post: Accepted changes stored; client receives delta/acknowledgement.
